translations.web: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.
translations.bsb: But Saul was empowered all the more, and he confounded the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Christ.
translations.kjv: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
